evidence.notes: Integer and Date+Time overloads construct through the current user timezone for the modeled named-zone slice.
Local getters use the current user timezone while GMT variants stay UTC.
Modeled gaps roll forward by the transition gap; overlaps choose the earlier instant.
System.runAs current-user timezone returns a TimeZone object inside the modeled named-zone slice.

source.content: @isTest private class CoreDatetimeLocalTimezoneFixtureTest { @isTest static void localConstructionAndComponents() { System.runAs(new User(Id = '005-pacific-user', TimeZoneSidKey = 'America/Los_Angeles')) { TimeZone userZone = UserInfo.getTimeZone(); System.assertEquals('America/Los_Angeles', userZone.getID()); Datetime winterLocal = Datetime.newInstance(2024, 2, 29, 23, 5, 6); System.assertEquals('2024-03-01 07:05:06', winterLocal.formatGmt('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')); System.assertEquals('2/29/2024, 11:05 PM', winterLocal.format()); System.assertEquals(Date.newInstance(2024, 2, 29), winterLocal.date()); System.assertEquals(Date.newInstance(2024, 3, 1), winterLocal.dateGmt()); System.assertEquals(Time.newInstance(23, 5, 6, 0), winterLocal.time()); System.assertEquals(Time.newInstance(7, 5, 6, 0), winterLocal.timeGmt()); System.assertEquals(2024, winterLocal.year()); System.assertEquals(2, winterLocal.month()); System.assertEquals(29, winterLocal.day()); System.assertEquals(23, winterLocal.hour()); System.assertEquals(5, winterLocal.minute()); System.assertEquals(6, winterLocal.second()); System.assertEquals(2024, winterLocal.yearGmt()); System.assertEquals(3, winterLocal.monthGmt()); System.assertEquals(1, winterLocal.dayGmt()); System.assertEquals(7, winterLocal.hourGmt()); System.assertEquals(5, winterLocal.minuteGmt()); System.assertEquals(6, winterLocal.secondGmt()); Datetime fromDateTime = Datetime.newInstance(Date.newInstance(2024, 7, 1), Time.newInstance(5, 30, 0, 250)); System.assertEquals('2024-07-01 12:30:00.250', fromDateTime.formatGmt('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS')); Datetime fromDateTimeGmt = Datetime.newInstanceGmt(Date.newInstance(2024, 7, 1), Time.newInstance(5, 30, 0, 250)); System.assertEquals('2024-07-01 05:30:00.250', fromDateTimeGmt.formatGmt('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS')); Datetime gap = Datetime.newInstance(2024, 3, 10, 2, 30, 0); System.assertEquals('2024-03-10 10:30:00', gap.formatGmt('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')); System.assertEquals('3/10/2024, 3:30 AM', gap.format()); Datetime overlap = Datetime.newInstance(2024, 11, 3, 1, 30, 0); System.assertEquals('2024-11-03 08:30:00', overlap.formatGmt('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')); System.assertEquals('11/3/2024, 1:30 AM', overlap.format()); } } }
